_instructions: Historical Power Rank / Power Score / Playoff Odds data recovered from past seasons, before this site existed. Keyed by season year, then by Sleeper username. 'pre' is the preseason rank/score (null where it wasn't tracked that year, and n/a for playoffOdds); 'weekly' is an array of values, one per week, starting at Week 1. A null entry in a weekly array means that week wasn't recorded (2022's Power Score and Playoff Odds are both missing Week 10; Power Score is also missing Week 14). Ranks: 1 = best. Scores (2021+): raw weighted PR Score, lower is better. Playoff Odds (2021+): percent chance of making the playoffs, higher is better. Note: 'Pathieu' (2021-2022) and 'paty23' (2023+) are two DIFFERENT people (both named Patrick) -- Pathieu left the league and paty23 joined afterward -- so they are kept as separate entries, not merged.
